briefdescription.para: Single inclusion point that registers every API v2 Drogon controller.

detaileddescription.para: Drogon discovers controllers through the static registration performed by each included header's METHOD_LIST macros; this aggregator has no logic of its own. Include it where the whole v2 route set must be linked in (e.g. application startup), and rely on the per-controller METHOD_ADD declarations for paths, verbs and filter chains. The IWYU pragmas keep the headers as explicit dependencies even though no symbol from them is named here.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: This is the "one-stop shop" for the whole version-2 HTTP API. When the server starts, including this single header pulls in every route controller (appointments, clients, clinics, docs, hello, services and staff). Drogon registers each controller automatically just because its header is seen, so this file is what makes all those URLs actually exist. Without it, none of the v2 endpoints would be reachable and the API would be empty.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
Static registration: simply including a header can register code with a framework, without calling any function yourself.
HTTP filters/middleware: https://drogon.docsforge.com/master/filter/
CORS: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/CORS
